描述_ZN: Huangfu Dan Stele", made by Yu Zhining, written by Ouyang Xun, engraved in Tang Dynasty, with Song topography, mounted in a booklet, with 32 pages, each page 30.2 cm long and 16.4 cm wide.　　Inscribed by Zhang Zuyi and Zhu Yizhi, with four seals, including "Yizhi Jianzhi" and "Lujiang Liu Jianzhi Jianzhi's graphite collection". This is the undamaged version of the character "務" in the phrase "參综機务".　　The inscription is in 28 lines, with 59 characters. The seal script has 12 characters in Yang. There is no year in the inscription, but according to the previous people, it was established at the time of Gaozu Wu De, and it is also said that it was established at the beginning of Zhenguan, and the Song fashion was in Ming Calf Town of Xianning. In the shade of the stele is the inscription "Record of the restoration of the Vaisnava Institute", which was carved in 1051. The side of the monument was originally engraved with a flower pattern, but the name was engraved on the right side in the Song Dynasty. Later it was moved to the Temple of Literature of Xi'an Prefecture. In the 16th year of the Ming Dynasty (1588), Yu Junfang made a pavilion to cover it, but when the pavilion collapsed in the 24th year, the stele was interrupted and dozens of characters were lost. It is now in the Xi'an Stele Forest Museum.　　The calligraphy of this stele is in the style of the Northern Qi Dynasty, with strong bones and a strict law. Wang Shizhen of the Ming Dynasty said, "The rate of the more book "Huangfu Jun Stele" is especially dangerous and strong compared to other stele. It is the origin of the Lantai of the Yi family, but the Lantai "Dao Yin stele", the pen with the batch (official method), get the house of learning."　　It was recorded in Zhao Mingcheng's "Jin Shi Lu" in Song Dynasty, Sun Chengze's "Geng Zi Pin Xia Ji" and Zhu Feng's "Yong Zhou Jin Shi Ji" in Qing Dynasty.
